paragraphs.text: North Pontotoc and Pontotoc open district soccer on the same evening, but families following the boys teams will need two different kickoff times. Thursday, Dec. 3, the Warriors play at Lafayette at 7 p.m. and the Vikings host New Albany in Ecru at 8 p.m. Both girls games begin at 5 p.m. South Pontotoc opens its district schedule at home the next night against Ripley.

The boys game in Ecru pairs two teams that shut out Mooreville by at least seven goals. North Pontotoc beat Mooreville 7–0 on Nov. 17. New Albany won 8–0 in its opener on Oct. 27. The Vikings won all five games on their results sheet before Thanksgiving, scoring 35 goals. The Bulldogs closed their November schedule with a 3–2 win over Clinton.

At Lafayette, Pontotoc’s girls bring back-to-back 7–0 wins over Grenada and Strayhorn. Lafayette has two seven-goal shutouts of its own this month, against Booneville and Hancock. Southaven gives the teams another point of comparison. Pontotoc won that matchup 2–0 and Lafayette won 4–0. The Warrior boys also shut out Grenada and Strayhorn, scoring nine goals across the two games.

South Pontotoc’s girls play Ripley at 5 p.m. Friday, Dec. 4, and the boys follow at 7. Fans can see the Cougars twice at home that week. New Hope visits Tuesday, Dec. 1, at the same times. Ripley’s boys beat Saltillo 4–0 in their most recent reported game and are scheduled to start district play at Byhalia on Nov. 30, four days before visiting the Cougars.
